title: Weak Factorization and Product Systems Over Groupoids
summary: We give a product-system description of generalized higher-rank graphs with the weak factorization property. For such a graph with degree-zero groupoid G, we prove that weak factorization is equivalent to multiplication inducing coherent bijections between balanced products of its homogeneous G-G-bisets. Consequently, generalized higher-rank graphs with fixed degree-zero groupoid are equivalent to normalized product systems of groupoid bisets over N^k.
